scope: Read-only actual-code final architecture, maintenance and extension review; only this research JSON written. Current legal-run scientific failure is not inferred from structural debt.

findings.title: Primitive binding depends on other physics category implementation
findings.observation: Thermophoresis/lift/ion binders choose their own primitive offsets by drag/thermophoresis/charge plan type and reuse already-bound category fields, despite one existing sampled_values name-to-offset map.
findings.impact: An additional or removed drag/charge model can require unrelated force binders to change, so scientifically independent categories are not locally extensible. Current catalog compatibility checks support current combinations; wrong force values for current legal input were not newly demonstrated.
findings.root_improvement: Bind each model role directly through the existing deduplicated field map; retain explicit actual physical background compatibility checks once.

findings.title: Accepted material state transition owned in three paths
findings.observation: Curved/exact/surface response paths each canonicalize hit, update resident x/v/Z, both ordinals and lifecycle, append boundary event and count interactions before method-specific continuation.
findings.impact: A lifecycle/RNG/event schema change must preserve the same update in three places, with subtle partial-failure and surface-departure differences. No new present event-physics failure established.
findings.root_improvement: One accepted material impact update over existing ParticleState, called after accepted prefix and before method-specific continuation; preserve axis/periodic and surface post-departure failure semantics separately.

findings.title: Production force arithmetic has multiple maintained bodies
findings.observation: Epstein rate formula is independently handwritten in array owner and compiled row; runtime preparation calls the array rate for global bounds while actual stage uses compiled row. OML point-law arithmetic likewise has array and compiled bodies.
findings.impact: A physical formula/revision correction can leave preparation, compiled evaluation and explanation inconsistent even with one engine. Distinct bound proofs and independent test oracles are necessary and should not be mechanically unified.
findings.root_improvement: Share hot scalar production laws family by family; preserve directed rounding, distinct domain/global/local proof mathematics and independently derived verification.

findings.title: Parent schedule/explanation fields remain in worker preparation payload
findings.observation: PreparedTransport contains full frame/probe tuples, field split tuple, Python boundary rules, explanatory stability values and full PhysicsPlan/memory plan, and the whole prepared record is serialized for spawn. Known parent-only tuples have no prepared-attribute numerical read in worker; this excludes actual field snapshot times and particle-local/root times.
findings.impact: Observation schedule length increases child preparation pickle size and parent/worker ownership is less precise. Existing measured witness grows21905 to58771bytes for4096 frame/probe times; no current RSS cap breach is demonstrated.
findings.root_improvement: Move zero-read host fields first; project required worker capacities/noise controls and runtime packing inputs before removing full plans, with shared-array/replay/worker identity checks.

findings.title: Execution facts are incompletely or multiply projected to explanations and verification
findings.observation: resolved_models emits identities plus only selected Talbot/lift/cap scalars, without full role-to-field mapping. Installed acceptance duplicates four example names and literal five-passed while production inventory owns five names. Physics document lists ion drag last while compiled stage evaluates it after thermophoresis.
findings.impact: Result-only scientific explanation is incomplete, example additions/removals can stale installed acceptance, and numerical-order documentation does not reflect actual order. All current five examples remain exercised; input hashes still bind original input; current accumulation order is not claimed wrong.
findings.root_improvement: One complete flat resolved model fact projection; installed inventory consumed by acceptance with executed names/outcomes; update documentation to actual addition order without reordering numerical code.

R03.status: current latent extension hazard, not current catalog wrong-physics evidence
R03.meaning: Top-level prepare family/type mismatch does reject. Some lower local/continuous proof functions interpret remaining numeric code as a known family; future stage-family additions need explicit proof construction rather than relying on residual branches.

additional_status.R18: current inventory extension seam, not missing current example acceptance
additional_status.R19: current document/order mismatch, not proof of incorrect arithmetic

strengths: One public engine and sole installed CLI; core/client/external COMSOL dependency directions are explicit, old runtime/compatibility removal independently audited.
Typed current model plans and fixed compiled records; SI, field support/value separation and independent particle property authorities retained.
Check and run share preparation; global coverage, local applicability, constant specializations are explicit separate capabilities.
Geometry first-hit, law response, accepted prefix and continuation have meaningful boundaries; stable particle IDs and wall draw ordinals are preserved.
Parent-only writer, bounded IPC ACK, shared resident arrays and private scratch lifetime have concrete owners.
Independent analytic/Decimal/OU/covariance/conditional-tree/wall/memory ownership checks remain, rather than only old-output golden identity.

criteria.criterion: Change locality and single fact/math authority
Verification and explanation support for safe changes
Adding another model within an existing category
Adding categories or genuine coupled state

scores.interpretation: Engineering judgment of current supported alpha, not probability/percentage of correct physics. Necessary mathematical coupling for a new state is not penalized; redundant mappings/reinterpretations are.

conclusion: The supported research/expert alpha has a usable coherent base. Retirement completion does not close remaining responsibility/locality/explanation debt; generic frequent model additions/removals still require coordinated changes across multiple owners.
recommended_order: B05 typed resolved facts/direct roles and explicit proof construction
B07 parent/worker and resident input boundary
limits: No exhaustive every-line/every-model-combination audit or new mathematical rederivation
Current gate/test execution independently owned by root; prior unchanged source-bound suite evidence is not recounted as this reviewer execution
User-facing input defects and native/comparison qualification are separate reviewer domains
